serverInfo.title: Kifly — Agentic Commerce & Payments
serverInfo.description: Infrastructure layer for agent commerce. Discover products across multiple sellers, manage a cart, and check out via a secure Stripe-powered payment link on kifly.ai for physical goods. Buyer identity management: register, recover via email OTP, save shipping address — repeat buyers skip all manual data entry. Network tokens (kfn_live_) browse the full Kifly merchant network; seller tokens (kfa_live_) scope to one merchant. Hosted at https://kifly.ai — no local setup required.
